description:
## Why this ticket exists

T-007's publish act requires the owner's explicit in-session go-ahead and is never autonomous. But as of 2026-08-01 every decision the prep was waiting on is made (note N-001: spendbar is free forever and open source; licensing/repo/identity delegated and decided), so the preparation itself is now autonomous-safe. This ticket carries it, leaving T-007 as the short supervised act: version bump, `npm publish`, post-publish verification, tag.

## HARD STOP

This ticket ends at `npm publish --dry-run`. No command that publishes, and no version bump off `0.1.0-dev` (the bump is T-007's first supervised step). If anything here seems to require publishing, stop and report instead.

## Work items (in order)

1. **LICENSE**: copyright holder → `Copyright (c) 2026 spendbar contributors` (decision in N-001). Then REMOVE the LICENSE-copyright-line exemption from the tarball content scan in `tests-ts/contract/packaging.contract.mjs` so the scan runs with zero exemptions, and mutation-check it (re-adding a personal name anywhere in LICENSE must fail).
2. **README rewrite for npm**: it is still the Python tool's README and becomes the npm page. Required: spendbar name and `npm install -g spendbar`; `spendbar` subcommand synopsis; keep the accuracy/caveats and acknowledgements sections; no personal identifiers, no `<your-username>` placeholder, no clone-and-symlink install path; platform table per the ISS-013 decision — macOS supported; Windows/Linux CLI **experimental** with the exact caveat (HOME-vs-USERPROFILE resolution and backslash `~` forms unsupported until the Windows milestone). Trim `package.json` description/keywords to what 0.1.0 ships (roadmap lives in the README).
3. **ISS-013 follow-through**: once the honest platform table lands, downgrade ISS-013 to medium per the decision recorded in its impact, with a resolution-plan note pointing at the Windows milestone.
4. **usage.py:199 scrub**: replace the real rollout ID with the synthetic-UUIDv7 convention the fixtures use (real timestamp prefix + zeroed random bits). This is a COMMENT-ONLY exemption to the frozen-oracle rule, decided in N-001, and must be witnessed: `git diff usage.py` shows only that line; full `npm run test:all` green including parity `--final` 266/0/0 and 45/45 goldens byte-matching a live re-run.
5. **Script-disabled install matrix** (v0.1 phase exit criterion, still unmet): a re-runnable script installs the exact packed tarball with lifecycle scripts disabled under npm, pnpm, yarn, AND bun into clean prefixes; each runs `spendbar --help` (exit 0, `usage: spendbar [-h]`) and one invocation proving pinned ccusage 20.0.19 resolves offline (no network, no npx).
6. **Tarball audit**: `npm pack` → file list matches the contract allowlist exactly; content grep for `<maintainer-name>`, `<real-account>`, `/Users/`, and the rollout-ID pattern returns nothing (zero exemptions now); record tarball size and shasum.
7. **`npm publish --dry-run`** from the candidate commit; record exactly what npm says it will send. STOP.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Tarball content scan passes with its exemption list empty, and the mutation check proves it load-bearing.
2. README describes the npm package accurately (install, bin, synopsis, honest platform table) and contains no personal identifiers.
3. `git diff` for usage.py across this ticket's commits touches only the line-199 comment; parity + goldens green at HEAD.
4. The install-matrix script exists, is documented, and all four package managers pass with lifecycle scripts disabled.
5. `npm run test:all` green at the final commit; ISS-013 downgraded with its note.
6. No publish command was executed and version is still `0.1.0-dev`.

## Constraints (standing)

`usage.py` frozen except the witnessed comment-only scrub above; `package.json` never carries author/contributors/maintainers; no real transcript data or personal paths in anything committed; **no `npm publish`**.

**Decisions already made — do not re-open** (note N-001, owner delegation 2026-08-01): LICENSE holder, repository field intent (storybloq org, lands when the repo exists), publish identity (`<owner-npm-account>` + 2FA), dist-tag move accepted, Windows deferral.
title: Publish prep: LICENSE, README, oracle scrub, install matrix — everything EXCEPT npm publish
